plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-origin-rvc-check — Regional value content check for an origin determination register

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-origin-rvc-check` reads one origin determination register (原产地判定台账) — the agreement header plus one row per material — and checks that register's own arithmetic: that the agreement and product are declared, that regional value content equals (FOB − non-originating value) ÷ FOB × 100, that RVC meets the threshold you configure, that every material states its origin, that the origin criterion comes from your agreement's vocabulary, that material numbers are unique, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the description.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-origin-rvc-check: real output over its OR-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-origin-rvc-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-origin-rvc-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `OR-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| The 区域价值成分 column says `70.00`, but the row's 净价值 is `220` and the header's FOB is `400`. Is that caught? | Yes. `OR-002` recomputes the build-down formula (FOB − non-originating value) ÷ FOB × 100 from the 净价值 column and FOB, with a 0.5-point tolerance, and reports the row when the declared RVC differs. It does only the arithmetic, and it assumes the build-down method: a register filled in by the build-up method is reported although its own convention is right, so change `expression` or disable the rule. If the RVC, the 净价值 or the FOB cannot be read as a number, the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing silently. |
| No threshold is set anywhere, and every row passed. Did it check the RVC at all? | No. `OR-003` ships with `threshold: 0`, which means unconfigured, so the rule reports itself in `skipped` rather than passing silently. Set `threshold` to your agreement's figure (for example `40`) and it reports each row whose RVC falls below it. A finding means only “below the threshold you set” — not that the goods are not originating, because origin can also be earned through wholly-obtained or tariff-classification-change criteria; RVC is only one path. |
| One material row leaves 原产国 blank. | `OR-004` reports every row whose 原产国 (origin) column is present but empty. It checks only that the cell is filled, not whether the declared origin is true or whether it affects origin status; when the material carries no origin column at all, the rule reports that it does not apply instead of passing silently. |
| The 原产地标准 column holds a value that is not in my list. | `OR-005` compares each value with the pack's `values` list. That list ships empty — criterion names and abbreviations differ per agreement, so the plugin hard-codes none — and the rule then reports itself in `skipped`; fill `values` with your agreement's criteria (完全获得, CTC, RVC, 特定加工工序 …) and any value not on it is reported. It checks only that the value is on the list, not that the goods satisfy that criterion. |
| The same 料件序号 appears on two rows. | `OR-006` reports a repeated 料件序号 (itemNo), comparing the values with whitespace ignored. A duplicate double-counts the non-originating material value and therefore corrupts the RVC — this is the kind of defect that leads straight to a wrong conclusion. It reports the repetition; which of the two rows is wrong is not something it decides. |
| The 品名 column still reads `【待填】` for one material. | `OR-007` reports a row whose 品名 (description) contains any of the pack's `terms` — 【, 】, `{{`, `}}`, XXX, xxx, 待填, 待补充, TBD, todo, 示例. A register copied from a template looks as if the materials had been counted, and the RVC then rests on a list of materials that does not exist. Only the listed terms are looked for, so a placeholder nobody listed passes; `terms` follows your own template. |

## Standards it follows

This rule pack cites no public standard: the verification pass obtained no verbatim text from any free trade agreement's rules of origin, so every rule's `basis` says so, each is `derived-from-principle` and none rises above `warn` or `info`. What the checks rest on instead is the register's own arithmetic, plus the RVC threshold and the criterion vocabulary you configure for the agreement that applies.

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 各自由贸易协定原产地规则（协定文本，本次未取得） | 现行协定版本本次未核实 | OR-001, OR-002, OR-003, OR-004, OR-005, OR-006, OR-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **原产地判定台账** for arithmetic — that the agreement and product are
declared, that regional value content equals (FOB − non-originating value) ÷ FOB × 100, that RVC meets the
threshold you configure, that every material states its origin, that the origin criterion comes from your
agreement's vocabulary, that material numbers are unique, and that no placeholder survives. It does **not**
decide whether goods qualify as originating, whether a preferential rate applies, whether an origin declaration
is valid, or whether origin circumvention occurred.

> ### ⚠️ Origin rules are treaty text, and this pack does not pretend to quote one
>
> RVC and the other origin criteria — wholly obtained, change of tariff classification — are set by **each free
> trade agreement's rules of origin**. RCEP, ASEAN–China, China–Korea and the rest differ in their thresholds
> (40%, 30% and other tiers) and in their calculation methods. **The verification pass obtained no verbatim text
> from any agreement**, so every rule's `basis` says exactly that and stays at `warn` or `info`.
>
> Three consequences are worth knowing before trusting a finding:
>
> - **`OR-002` assumes the build-down method** — RVC = (FOB − VNM) ÷ FOB × 100. Some agreements permit the
>   **build-up** method (regional value ÷ FOB × 100), which yields a different number for the same goods. A
>   register computed that way will report a difference; change `expression` or disable the rule. The check
>   reads FOB and the net value through a header fallback, so a figure stated once for the whole set is found.
> - **`OR-003`'s threshold ships unset.** Thresholds vary by agreement *and* by tariff line, so the plugin
>   hard-codes none. A finding means "below the threshold you set", **not** "these goods are not originating" —
>   because origin can also be earned through wholly-obtained or tariff-classification-change criteria.
>   **RVC is only one path.** That distinction matters, and the rule's note states it.
> - **`OR-005`'s criterion vocabulary ships empty**; criterion names and abbreviations differ per agreement.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a full bill of materials use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `origin_rvc_check` tool. It reads one origin register — the agreement header plus one row per
material — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OR-001` | the agreement and product are declared | warn | principle |
| `OR-002` | RVC follows the deduction formula | warn | principle |
| `OR-003` | RVC meets your configured threshold (off by default) | info | local |
| `OR-004` | every material states its origin | warn | principle |
| `OR-005` | the criterion comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `OR-006` | material numbers are unique | warn | principle |
| `OR-007` | the description holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-origin-rvc-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-origin

plugins.description: Docs before code: one page per feature so your agent stops grepping and starts knowing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-feature-map A DeepSeek Harness plugin that makes an agent read your project's documentation before it reads your source.
[![CI](https://github.com/megablue/dsh-feature-map/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/megablue/dsh-feature-map/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/package-json/v/megablue/dsh-feature-map?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/megablue/dsh-feature-map/blob/main/package.json) [![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/your-owner/your-plugin-slug) [![Node: 22](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-22.x-339933.svg?style=flat-square&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/megablue/dsh-feature-map/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) [![Dependencies: none](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-none-brightgreen.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/megablue/dsh-feature-map/blob/main/package.json) [![Buy me a coffee](https://img.shields.io/badge/buy%20me%20a%20coffee-PayPal-ffdd00.svg?style=flat-square&logo=buymeacoffee&logoColor=black)](https://www.paypal.me/mega3dp)
Finding the code for one area usually means grepping the tree, opening three files, and working out which parts matter. A feature map replaces that with one page per feature — the files, types, tests and traps for that area — so the agent can ask for exactly the piece it needs. `dsh-feature-map` puts that map in the agent's prompt, gives it five tools to read the map at whatever size the question deserves, and refuses the first source lookup of a session in a project that has a map, once, with the reason and the remedy. It also gets you the map in the first place: `feature_map_init` for a project that has nothing, `feature_map_adopt` for one that already has documentation, and `feature_map_regen` for one whose map has outgrown its shape. ## What you get | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `feature_map` | Reads the map: the index, the sections for a topic, one page's shape, one section, one `###`, or the whole page. | | `feature_map_check` | Reports drift — pages no index row links, rows whose link goes nowhere — and, separately, sections too big to read in one piece. | | `feature_map_init` | Scaffolds the workflow into a project: `AGENTS.md`, `HANDOFF.md`, `docs/SPEC.md` and the map index. | | `feature_map_adopt` | Reports what an existing project is missing, and writes only the files that do not exist. | | `feature_map_regen` | Rewrites an existing map so it reads well: the missing headings and `Status:` lines, every oversized section divided into `###`, and the index reconciled. | Plus a prompt section that states the read order, and a guard that enforces it once per session (see *What you will notice*). ## Install Copy-paste (verified on the `desktop` profile): dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:megablue/dsh-feature-map Or install from source. The plugin is a DSH **bundle**, so it installs from this directory and takes effect in the running app: - In the app's plugin settings, add this directory as a bundle. - Or, if you drive the harness from an agent session, install it with the plugin manager pointed at the absolute path of this checkout (`…\projects\dsh-feature-map`). It links the package, adds the `feature-map` row to the profile, and activates it live. A **code** change to the plugin itself needs an application restart: the profile does not watch module files, and toggling the plugin row re-applies the patch without reloading the module. Editing a *project's* docs needs nothing. Compatibility & permissions: targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, local workspaces. Reads `docs/features/` from the host filesystem; writes go through the harness filesystem seam under the profile's sandbox policy. No dependencies, no peer dependencies, no network calls. ## Starting a new project Two steps: get the documents, then fill in the parts only you can answer. **1. Ask for the scaffold.** Say *"scaffold the documentation workflow here"* — or name the tool, `feature_map_init`. It returns the four documents rendered for your project and writes nothing: | File | What it is for | | --- | --- | | `AGENTS.md` | Process and hard rules: the commands, the workflow, the constraints that apply to every change. | | `docs/features/README.md` | The map index and the page template — the entry point the agent reads first. | | `docs/SPEC.md` | User-visible behavior, readable without knowing the code. | | `HANDOFF.md` | Volatile session state: what is in flight, what is next. | **2. Write them.** Either ask for `feature_map_init` with `write: true` — which writes through the harness filesystem seam, so the profile's sandbox policy still applies — or write the returned text yourself. Existing files are never replaced; pass `force` only when you mean it. **3. Fill in the marked places.** The documents say what is still a placeholder: the layout, the commands and the hard rules in `AGENTS.md`, and the first row of the map index. A scaffolded document that ships unfilled reads as authoritative and says nothing — the placeholders are visible on purpose. **4. Write your first page.** Copy the page template out of `docs/features/README.md` and give it a feature: what it does, the names in it, how it works, its settings, the tests that pin it, and what it relates to. Then ask for `feature_map_adopt` — it generates the index row from the page's own title and `Read when:` line, so you do not hand-maintain the table. **5. Confirm.** `feature_map_check` should report the map agrees with itself. From then on the loop is the workflow the documents describe: read the map before the code, and update the page in the same commit as the change. ## Bringing an existing project `feature_map_adopt` is read-only unless you pass `apply: true`, and it **never edits a file that already exists**. What it reports depends on what you have. ### If you already have some form of feature map Ask for `feature_map_adopt` with no arguments. You get a one-line summary and five sections: - **Index** — rows whose link does not resolve, pages no row links, rows with no `Read when:` trigger, and the rows to add for anything unlinked. - **Pages** — which of the six mandated headings each page is missing, which pages have no `Status: … Read when:` line, which are not linked. - **Sections** — every section past the size limit, and whether it *already* divides at `###` level or genuinely needs splitting. A long section that is already divided is not work, and the report says so. - **AGENTS.md** — which of the template's blocks your instruction file lacks, by name. Your own wording is never touched; you get the missing blocks to paste. - **Outside the map** — markdown under `docs/` that is not a page of the map, with its size and section count. Reported, never moved: whether `docs/GAME.md` should become a feature page is your call, not the tool's. Then a **plan**, where every item is labelled `deterministic` (derived from what is already in your files — the index rows, the missing blocks) or `judgment` (a `Read when:` trigger, the content of a heading, where a long section splits). `apply: true` writes only the files that do not exist; everything else is text for you or your agent to place. If your map is already in good shape, this is short: it reports the drift, the oversized sections and the documents outside the map, and stops. ### If your map has outgrown its shape A map that was written before the workflow existed often reads as one long section that is too big to hand anyone in one piece. `feature_map_regen` rewrites it: it adds the missing `##` headings and a `Status: … Read when:` line, divides e

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subagent-codex-pro

English | [中文](docs/README.zh.md)

A Codex delegation tool that can carry **a model and a reasoning effort per
call** — the two things `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` cannot express.

```
tools.subagent_codex({
  description: "Probe output PROBE_OK",
  prompt: "Output exactly one line of text: PROBE_OK",
  model: "gpt-6-astra",
  reasoning_effort: "xhigh",
})
```

## The gap this fills

`subagent_codex`'s schema exposes only `description` and `prompt`, so a caller
cannot name a model or a thinking level. In a recorded session a model asked to
do exactly that tried the obvious thing and was refused:

```
ToolCallError: child model selection is disabled for this tool instance
```

The chain, from the harness source:

```
tool schema exposes model / reasoning_effort
  ← only when modelSelectionEnabled
modelSelectionEnabled ← modelSelectionSettings: true on the tool row
modelSelectionSettings: true ← requires a provider declaring `agentOptions`
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex ← declares NO_START_CAPABILITIES (no agentOptions)
                                → enabling it throws while the preset mounts
```

The Codex protocol supports both fields (`ThreadStartParams.reasoningEffort`,
`TurnStartParams.effort`); the official provider never sends them. Reported
upstream: <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9115>

There is a second, separate defect: enabling `modelSelectionSettings: true` on a
row whose provider is external (`codex-pro`) makes that row **silently**
register no tool at all — no error, no log, no failed-preset badge. A control row
identical except for the flag registers normally. Also in that report.

## How this works instead

Two layers, both under this package's control.

### Execution: the same protocol the official provider speaks

`src/wire.ts` and `src/run.ts` are a port of the official app-server adapter —
the initialize handshake, the ephemeral thread, thread/turn association
including notifications that arrive before `turn/start` returns, unattended
approval decisions, and terminal-answer selection by phase — with exactly two
additions:

```js
// thread/start
{ cwd, ephemeral, ...(model ? { model } : {}), reasoningEffort, ...THREAD_PERMISSION_PARAMS[mode] }
// turn/start
{ threadId, input: [...], effort }
```

Neither literal appears anywhere in the official adapter's 871 lines. Two
mechanical differences from the source: the JSON-RPC transport is this package's
own (`src/jsonrpc.ts`), and the app-server is started as
`<command> app-server --stdio` from `PATH` rather than from `@openai/codex`'s
manifest. `src/codex-exec.ts`, the earlier `codex exec` path, is retained and
tested but unused.

### Tool registration: this plugin's own context

The plugin registers the delegation tool **itself**, on `agent/created`, into
that Agent's own context — the path `dsh-plugin-lcu` uses for its tools:

```ts
ctx.on('agent/created', ({ agent }) => { if (!presetAllows(agent)) return; serve(agent) })
ctx.on('agent-preset/selected', (sessionId, preset) => { … })
// serve(): agent.ctx.tools.register(createCodexTool({ … }))
```

That keeps the harness's preset-row machinery out of the path entirely. A preset
needs no rows of its own: `presets` names the committed Agent presets that get
the tool — `daily` and `heavy` here.

Because the tool name is fixed, the official `tool-subagent-codex` row is
**disabled** in those presets. Two rows registering the same tool name in one
Agent's scope collide: the second registration throws and its tool silently never
appears.

**Whatever the prompt names is what runs.** `model` and `reasoning_effort` are in
the schema, and an explicit choice in the call wins; when a delegation names
neither, the choice stays with Codex's own configuration (`~/.codex/config.toml`)
— the plugin is configured without defaults so that nothing silently overrides
either. `modelSelection: false` hides the two fields entirely.

The Host's `subagent-model-selection` setting is deliberately **not** consulted.
It authorizes a child **LLM route** chosen from the DSH catalog and billed as
tokens, while a Codex delegation names a **Codex model id** under the Codex CLI's
own subscription: different resources, different namespaces. That setting can
neither authorize nor constrain this choice, and reading it would only couple the
tool to a setting that has nothing to say about it.

## Install

```sh
# as a bundle in a DSH profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-codex-pro
# or from a checkout, for development
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-subagent-codex-pro
```

## Verify

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test                                  # argv + tool-schema cases; live case skipped
CODEX_SUBAGENT_LIVE=1 npm test            # also runs gpt-6-astra + xhigh for real
```

The plugin logs every decision to `~/.dsh/codex-pro.log`:

```
apply: provider "codex-pro" registered with agentOptions: true; presets=["daily","heavy"]
decide … composed=standard header=standard -> skip
serve …: subagent_codex registered (modelSelection=true, background=true, via=app-server)
run: model=gpt-6-astra effort=xhigh cwd=… prompt=179B via=app-server
run: published 3f2a…
run done: text=8B
```

A verified end-to-end run: 30 s wall clock, the model's `PROBE_OK` returned as
the tool result. A real app-server run is also covered by the live test, which
opens a thread with `reasoningEffort` and a turn with `effort`.

## Making the answer machine-readable

`output_schema` hands Codex a JSON Schema its final answer must conform to, so a later step can read the
answer instead of parsing prose and hoping:

```js
tools.subagent_codex({
  description: "Smoke verdict",
  prompt: "Assess whether both endpoints returned 200.",
  output_schema: {
    type: "object",
    properties: { verdict: { type: "string", enum: ["pass", "fail"] }, count: { type: "number" } },
    required: ["verdict", "count"],
    additionalProperties: false,
  },
})
```

The schema must be object-rooted — the same rule the harness applies to a schema it passes a provider — because
Codex constrains a whole answer and a bare scalar has nowhere to put the shape. The app-server **enforces** it:
a measured run came back as `{"verdict":"pass","reason":"…","count":2}`, with no extra keys and every required
one present. The answer arrives as **text**, and that text is JSON.

It is sent on the turn, not the thread: the same field on `thread/start` is accepted and silently ignored — the
answer came back as prose. Measured both ways.

A provider the harness drives (`thread-subagent`) can also be given a schema by its row, and this plugin now
declares that capability and parses the answer so the caller receives `structured` as well as the text.

## Showing Codex a picture

`images` hands Codex pictures alongside the task, so it receives them as pictures instead of being told to go
and open a file:

```js
tools.subagent_codex({
  description: "Match this design",
  prompt: "Rebuild this screen's layout in the component below.",
  images: ["/tmp/design.png"],
})
```

Each path must be absolute, must exist, and must be a file; anything else fails the call before anything is
spawned. That check is not decoration: **the app-server silently ignores a `localImage` path that does not
exist** — measured, with the turn completing normally and no error item — so an unchecked typo would produce a
delegation that quietly lacks the picture the task was about.

The pictures are sent as the app-server's `localImage` variant, which is the one form it accepts without the
bytes travelling: its `image` variant wants an `ImageReference` this plugin cannot construct, and both
`{type:'image', data, mimeType}` and a `data:` URL are rejected outright. A host path needs no encoding.

Naming images does not disturb the thread: they belong to the turn, not to the thread, so a resumed thread can
be shown a new picture.

## Choosing the directory

A delegation runs in the session's working directory by default. `cwd` names another one:

```js
tools.subagent_codex({
  description: "Post-deploy UI smoke",
  prompt: "…",
  cwd: "/tmp/mesh-smoke/2026101

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lorebooklike-prompt-tool

**DSH的声明式提示词注入层。** 把什么时候、往提示词的哪个位置、以多大把握、注入或改写哪段文本变成一份可编辑、可热重载、可复现的 JSON 规则文件，搭配一个类酒馆世界书的图形编辑器。

> **注：这不是酒馆的dsh插件或替代前端、不是酒馆模拟器、不和角色卡交互、不适用于角色扮演和小说创作场景——它是提示词工程工具。**

## 灵感来源与致谢

这个插件的四项核心机制 **全部源自 [SillyTavern](https://github.com/SillyTavern/SillyTavern) 的世界书机制**。

| 从酒馆借鉴的机制                                           | 本插件的对应物                                         |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| 🔵 Constant（蓝灯）／🟢 Selective（绿灯）                   | `mode: "constant"` ／ `mode: "selective"`        |
| Primary Keys ＋ Secondary Keys                      | `keys` ＋ `keySecondary`                         |
| Secondary 逻辑：AND Any / AND All / NOT Any / NOT All | `keyLogic: "any" / "all" / "notAny" / "notAll"` |
| Scan Depth（回看最近 N 条消息）                             | `scanDepth`                                     |
| Probability（概率触发）                                  | `probability`                                   |
| Content 上的 Find/Replace 正则（含捕获组）                   | `replaces`                                      |
| `/pattern/flags` 字面量写法，且**正则优先于大小写与全词设置**          | 同样的优先级规则                                        |
| 「绿灯没给主键就永不触发」这种安全默认                                | 同样是默认                                           |

> **版权声明**：本仓库**不含任何一行酒馆代码**，只参考其被开源社区验证过的**行为逻辑**和**设计哲学**。


---
# （以下全部内容均由蓝色大肥鱼书写）

## 设计边界

- **不新增会话事件类型**——所以旧版本 harness 仍能加载本插件产生的日志。
- **不改 `agent-loop`**，不动任何框架源码。
- **所有注册走 `ctx.effect()` / 注册表 API**，卸载时 section 会整批注销（冒烟测试里有专门一项断言）。
- **不注册任何工具**。规则完全由人工编排——一个能自助改写注入规则的 Agent 不再可审计。
- **零 `@deepseek-ai/*` 运行时依赖**，只需要 `node:*`。
- 不做角色卡、不做 RP 前端、不做记忆——那些是别的插件的事。

## 和酒馆的区别

拿掉角色扮演这个使用背景之后，酒馆的很多设计**在 DSH 里直接照搬是行不通的**，这是宿主的注入面不同导致的必然结果。

| 能力        | 含义                                                       |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| **分层提示词** | 每个条目声明一个语义化层锚点，精确插进系统提示的指定位置，**与 DSH 自己的段落交错**，而不是一律堆在末尾 |
| **蓝绿灯**   | 蓝灯（constant）无条件常驻；绿灯（selective）按关键词/正则命中才激活              |
| **概率激活**  | 条目可按概率抽取，**且结果可复现**——同一会话同一轮次永远得到同一个判定                   |
| **正则替换**  | 按作用面（条目正文 / 整段系统提示 / 用户消息）做正则改写，支持捕获组                    |

### 1. 「位置」的含义完全不同

酒馆的位置是**相对角色卡**的：before/after char definition、AN top/bottom、at depth。它有一套聊天消息数组，投喂点就是其中几个插槽。

DSH 没有角色卡，但它有一个**分段装配、有官方锚点序号的系统提示**。所以本插件的 `layer` 直接对齐 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` 导出的 `SECTION_ORDERS` 常量——「插到工具指引之后、文件交付引用之前」这种意图可以精确表达，不用猜魔数：

```text
 0  harness:identity              (-1000)
 1  lorebook-prompt:layer-early      (-500)   before-persona
 2  deployment:persona-prefix     (0)
 3  lorebook-prompt:sys-redact       (700)
 4  ref:middle                    (3000)
 5  lorebook-prompt:green-never      (3150)   tool-policy
 6  deployment:persona-suffix     (10200)
 7  lorebook-prompt:layer-late       (10300)  tail
 8  ref:hidden                    (11000)
```

（这是 `test/integration.mjs` 在**真实** `SystemPrompt` 服务上装配出来的实际顺序，不是示意。）

### 2. 概率必须是确定性的

酒馆是直接获取随机数。**本插件不能。**

DSH 有一条硬规则：**模型可见 ⟺ 已记录**。会话日志必须能完整重放模型当时看到的内容。真随机会让重放得到与当初不同的结果，直接违反这条铁律；再叠加上下文缓存按**前缀**匹配，逐轮抖动的系统提示会把缓存全部打废。

所以概率门用的是 FNV-1a 稳定哈希而不是 `Math.random()`：同一 `(条目 id, seedSalt, 会话, 轮次)` 永远得到同一个判定。

> **「概率 30%」在本插件里的准确含义是「按轮次确定性抽取」，不是「每次掷骰子」。**
> 对提示词工程来说这反而更好用：你得到的是可复现、可调试的行为，而不是一个无法复现的噪声源。

### 3. 多出来的一层：通道（channel）

酒馆只有一个注入面（聊天消息数组）。DSH 有两个：

|      | `channel: "system"`  | `channel: "message"`                          |
| ---- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| 落点   | 系统提示的有序段落            | 转换成 user 角色快照的动态上下文（`systemPrompt.context()`） |
| 作用域  | 每会话稳定                | 每轮独立                                          |
| 概率语义 | 按**会话**抽取（系统提示不逐轮抖动） | 按**轮次**抽取（可复现但会变）                             |
| 适合   | 风格约束、工具约定、分层规则       | 关键词触发的临时指令、概率性提醒                              |

**你要的是「每轮有一定概率追加一段提示」，就用 `message` 通道。** 详见下面的缓存安全一节。

### 4. 明确被移除的东西

| 酒馆有                       | 本插件  | 为什么                                                                                            |
| ------------------------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Token Budget / 预算裁剪       | ❌ 不要 | DSH 自己管系统提示的分段装配与预算。插件再插一层预算分配，会和宿主打架，而且它不知道自己排在第几段之前。                                         |
| Recursion（条目命中后触发更多条目）    | ❌ 不要 | 递归注入会让**扫描文本自己污染自己**——这是个大坑：用已注入后的消息做扫描源，一条正文里含自身触发词的绿灯条目会永远自我续命。已修，并且有了回归断言。递归会把同一类问题放大到不可审计。 |
| Sticky / Cooldown / Delay | ❌ 不要 | 这些是有状态的时序机制，与「日志可重放」冲突。                                                                        |
| Group Scoring / 权重抽签      | ❌ 不要 | 组内抽签本质是随机，同上。                                                                                  |
| 角色卡、Persona、RP 前端、聊天记忆    | ❌ 不要 | 那是别的插件的职责。见下一节。                                                                                |
| Vectorized / 向量检索条目       | ❌ 暂不 | 需要 embedding 服务依赖；不想为了一个可选项把插件从「零依赖纯数据变换」变成「需要外部服务」。                                           |

---

## 生态位空缺

这个生态位不是空的。检索依据：市场自己的目录（awesome-dsh-plugin，npm 包 `dsh-plugin-catalog`，构建号 `2026.1010.4974`），共 **4471 个插件**，按「世界书/lorebook」「系统提示注入」「关键词触发注入」「正则改写」等关键词做了三轮全量检索。所以下面是按公开描述划出的功能范围。

| 插件                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 它做的事                                                                    | 和本插件的差别                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **[dsh-universal-worldbook](https://github.com/TritiumWang/dsh-universal-worldbook)** ⭐3                                                                                                                                                                             | 酒馆风格的**通用**世界书：请求级一次性提示词注入，兼容酒馆世界书格式，关键词/正则/常驻触发，另带 `lore_lookup` 查询工具  | **最接近的先例，也是唯一一个把世界书从 RP 里剥出来的。** 但它固定走「给最新一条用户消息附加一次性注入」，也就是**放弃系统提示分层**——那恰好是本插件缓存安全改道的降级行为。它把这当成唯一模式，本插件把它当成兜底。另：无 npm 包，只能从 GitHub 装。 |
| **[Lume](https://github.com/cayan0x/Lume)** ⭐4 / 3905 dl                                                                                                                                                                                                             | 纪律层插件，「约束按需注入，闲聊轮不额外加 token；**注入分层（系统段只放恒定内容，易变内容随对话尾部快照下发），前缀缓存每步可用**」 | 分层思路和缓存处理**与本插件高度一致**——这是全部 4471 个插件里唯一在自述里明确提「前缀缓存」的。但它的规则是**插件内置的固定纪律**，用户不能编排；分层是它的实现细节，不暴露给用户。                                       |

# dsh-translate-on-select

**DSH 划词翻译插件：鼠标选中非中文内容后，在选区下方就地浮出一张卡片显示简体中文译文。**

选中即翻 —— 不用快捷键、不用装浏览器扩展、不用离开当前页面。

![翻译卡片示意图](docs/preview.svg)

> 上图是卡片外观的**示意**（非真实截图）。实际效果：选中一段外文 → 松手约 200ms → 选区正下方出现译文卡片。

---

## 特性

- **划词即译**：松开鼠标约 200ms 后自动翻译，落点在选区正下方（下方空间不够会自动翻到上方）。
- **自动判断要不要翻**：纯中文选区直接跳过（省掉一次「翻完还是原文」的无用请求）；日语、韩语因为有假名/谚文会被正确判定为「需要翻译」。
- **不打扰输入**：在输入框、文本域、`contenteditable` 里的选区不会触发。
- **自动识别源语言**：英文、日文、德文等都能识别，卡片上会显示「英语 → 简体中文」。
- **缓存**：同一段文本第二次选中是**瞬时**返回（内存 LRU，宿主与前端各一层）。
- **美观且跟主题**：毛玻璃卡片、圆角、柔和投影，自动跟随 DSH / 系统的明暗主题；带骨架屏加载态；尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
- **可交互**：一键复制译文、重新翻译、Esc / 点空白处关闭。
- **多后端回退**：主用 cn.bing.com，失败自动切 MyMemory。
- **零依赖、零构建**：纯 JavaScript，没有第三方依赖，也没有 `prepare`/`build` 脚本。

## 安装

需要已安装 `dsh` CLI（DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端自带，源码运行时用 `pnpm dsh`）。

### 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:syzke/dsh-translate-on-select
```

- 需要本机装了 `git`（pnpm 通过 git 拉取源码）。
- `desktop` 是桌面客户端的 profile；如果你跑的是 `dsh web`，把 `--profile desktop` 换成 `--profile web`。
- 本插件**没有 `prepare` 脚本**，所以 pnpm 不会要求你在 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里追加 `allowBuilds` 授权，装完即可用。
- 想锁定版本：先给仓库打 tag（如 `v0.1.0`），再 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:syzke/dsh-translate-on-select#v0.1.0`。

### 方式二：本地源码安装（改代码立即生效）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-translate-on-select"
```

> `link:` 是软链安装：源码改动**立即生效**（前端改完硬刷新即可，宿主改完要重启客户端）。
> 代价是**不能移动或重命名该源码目录**，移动后要重新 `add` 一次。
> 想改成拷贝安装（此后源码改动不再同步）用 `file:<路径>`。

### ⚠️ 装完必须重启一次客户端

`webserver/index-inject` 的注入行**不会热生效**，需要**重启一次 DeepSeek Harness**；只刷新页面（F5 / Ctrl+F5）是不够的。

原因：桌面端的注入表由 `dsh-desktop-host` 在**宿主启动时一次性收集**（`collectIndexInjections()`），Electron 主进程把它缓存成数组，之后每次 `dsh-desktop:boot` IPC 都返回**同一份**。所以哪怕是整页重载，拿到的还是启动那一刻的旧表 —— 新加的注入行必须靠**重启应用**才会被重新收集。

重启后自检：

1. 右下角**不应**出现任何东西（本插件没有常驻图标，这是正常的）。
2. 在任意助手回复里**用鼠标选中一段英文** → 选区下方应浮出译文卡片。
3. 若没反应：打开开发者工具看 Console 有没有 `/dsh-translate/client.js` 的报错；Network 里应能看到该请求返回 200。

## 配置

配置文件在 `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-translate.json`（Windows 默认即 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\.dsh-translate.json`），首次改配置时才会创建：

```json
{
  "to": "zh-Hans",
  "enabled": true
}
```

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `to` | 目标语言。`zh-Hans`=简体中文（默认）；也支持 `zh-Hant`、`en`、`ja` 等。**Bing 用 BCP-47 码**，改这个就能当反向词典用。 |
| `enabled` | 设为 `false` 可整体关掉翻译（插件仍加载，但接口会直接返回「已关闭」）。 |

改完**不用重启**（每次请求都重新读文件）。

### 环境变量（可选）

| 变量 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `DSH_TRANSLATE_CONTACT` | MyMemory 的联系邮箱。匿名额度约 5000 字符/天，填了可提到 5 万。 |
| `DSH_TRANSLATE_TRUSTED_HOSTS` | 逗号分隔。仅当**宿主信任栅栏不可用**且你把 DSH 放在了反代/局域网后面时才需要。 |

## 安全与隐私

- 翻译请求在**宿主侧**发出，只监听 `127.0.0.1`（DSH 默认绑定），不对外暴露。
- 所有路由都套了信任栅栏，三层策略：**自身校验**（拒绝 `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`；有 Origin 时必须与 Host 同源）→ **委托宿主栅栏** `ctx.connection.requestRejection` → **fail-closed**（栅栏抛异常按拒绝处理）。没有宿主栅栏时只放行回环地址 / `DSH_TRANSLATE_TRUSTED_HOSTS`。
- **请知悉**：翻译走的是**公共免费接口**，也就是**你选中的文本会被发送到 cn.bing.com（必要时还有 MyMemory）**。不要用它翻密钥、隐私数据或未公开的代码。

## 已知限制

- **译文是「重排版」的**：长文本按 4000 字符分片，各片独立翻译后拼接，所以长段的换行可能与原文不完全一致（字符顺序与内容不丢）。
- **延迟**：短句约 0.7–1.4s，2000 字符级别约 4s。没有流式输出，用骨架屏顶着。
- **公共接口的稳定性不由我们控制**：Bing 的 `ttranslatev3` 靠页面里的 `params_AbusePreventionHelper` token（1 小时有效，自动续期），页面结构变了就可能失效；MyMemory 匿名额度很小。两者都挂时会显示带原因的失败卡片，可点 ⟳ 重试。
- 滚动或缩放窗口时卡片会**收起**（选区会跟着动，钉在原位必然错位）。
- 选中 20000 字符以上不翻译。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-translate-on-select
```

然后重启客户端。

## 实现说明

```
dsh-translate-on-select/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch → cordis.patch.yml
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载声明
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # 宿主：注入行 + 本地路由 + 信任栅栏 + 配置
│   └── providers.mjs     # 翻译后端：Bing / MyMemory + 分片 + 缓存
├── assets/
│   └── translate.js      # 前端：选区监听 + 卡片（样式内嵌）
├── test/
│   └── providers-test.mjs # 后端自测（会真实联网）
└── docs/preview.svg      # 卡片外观示意
```

### 数据流

```
页面选区 ──► assets/translate.js ──POST /dsh-translate/translate──► lib/index.js
                                                                      │
                                                       lib/providers.mjs
                                                      ├─ Bing（cn.bing.com，主）
                                                      └─ MyMemory（备）
```

翻译放在**宿主侧**而不是浏览器里直接调，有三个好处：绕开 CORS、能集中做缓存/分片/多后端回退、能把探测到的真实语言回传给界面显示。

### 为什么用 `webserver/index-inject` 而不是 `dsh.client`

DSH 确实有 `dsh.client` 客户端插件机制（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})`），但它是**槽位（slot）导向**的：UI 只能注册进 DSH 已声明的具名槽位（如 `conversation.composer.dock`）。本插件要的是**覆盖任意页面内容的全局浮层**，没有对应槽位，所以走注入行这条路。

注入行必须是**内联脚本**（`kind:'script'`）而不是 `kind:'script-src'`：页面侧解释器对后者是「加载失败即 reject 掉 `__DSH_BOOT_READY__`，整个应用起不来」。内联行里由我们自己创建 `<script src>` 并吞掉 `onerror`，这样插件被停用、路由注销时只会静默失败，绝不会把宿主拖死。

## 开发

```sh
# 语法检查（离线）
node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/providers.mjs && node --check assets/translate.js

# 后端自测（会真实请求 cn.bing.com / MyMemory）
node test/providers-test.mjs
```

- 改 `assets/translate.js`（前端 / 样式）→ 卡片不出现或样式不对时，**Ctrl+F5 硬刷新**即可，不用重启。
- 改 `lib/*.js`（宿主 / 路由 / 后端）→ 需要**重启客户端**。

## 可能的后续增强

- **换成 DSH 自带模型**：`ctx.llm.stream()` + `ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` 是公开可用的（`dsh-session-title-llm` 就是现成范例）。这样质量更好、无需第三方出网、不用公共接口，代价是消耗你自己的模型额度。当前 `providers.mjs` 的结构就是为这种替换留的（一个 provider 就是 `{label, maxChunk, translate}`）。
- 命中缓存时右侧显示「原文 → 译文」对照。
- 加一个快捷键（如 Alt+Shift+T）对当前选区强制翻译，绕过「已是中文则跳过」的判断。

## English

A select-to-translate plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop app. Select any
non-Chinese text with the mouse, and a floating card with the Simplified Chinese
translation appears right below the selection — no hotkey, no browser extension,
no leaving the page.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:syzke/dsh-translate-on-select
```

Then **restart the app once** (the injection table is collected at host startup and
is not hot-reloaded). Text you select is sent to the public cn.bing.com translator
(falling back to MyMemory); do not use it on secrets or private data.

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)。翻译内容来自第三方公共接口，其准确性不作保证。

# dsh-plugin-design-forge

**DeepSeek Harness 设计库插件** — 抓取优秀网站的真实设计，沉淀为本地设计库，并在你做网站 / 应用界面 / 文档排版时自动套用。

English summary below.

## 它做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `design_capture` | 抓取一个网站（走 Harness 的 `ctx.web` 通道，自动继承你配置的 fetch provider —— 包括 SOCKS 代理路由），解析页面内联样式 + 全部可达样式表（含一级 `@import`），蒸馏出：调色板（含使用频次与明暗分类）、字体族与完整 font stack、字号阶梯、字重、行高、字距、间距节奏、圆角、阴影、渐变、动效时长与缓动、断点、容器宽度、`@font-face`，以及站点自己的 CSS 自定义属性 token（自动区分 light / dark 主题）。结果存为一个 JSON 条目 + 一份可直接粘贴的 `tokens.css`。 |
| `design_library` | 管理设计库：`list`（总览每条设计的调色板/字体/阶梯）、`search`（按 id/名称/颜色/字体检索）、`get`（完整分析）、`export`（`tokens` = tokens.css、`spec` = Markdown 设计规范、`json` = 原始条目）、`delete`。 |
| `design_discover` | **一次调用完成「搜索 → 筛选 → 批量收录」**：按 query 走 Harness 的搜索通道，过滤掉平台/聚合站（YouTube、GitHub、Dribbble、知乎…）、文档与子页面、图片与 PDF 等资源、以及同一域名的重复项，优先落地页（首页与浅层路径），然后逐个抓取入库，返回每个站点的调色板/字体/字阶/圆角/token 数量摘要。用 `urls` 可跳过搜索直接批量收录已知站点。 |
| 系统提示注入 | 一个 guidance section 教会每个 Agent：**做网站、应用界面、仪表盘、邮件、海报、幻灯片、文档排版之前，先查设计库**，命中则复用该设计的 token 作为设计系统（并注明来源）；库为空、或没有匹配目标气质的条目时，主动 `design_discover` 去搜集参考站；用户分享/称赞某网站时，主动建议或直接 `design_capture` 收录。 |

这就是"自动用上"的实现方式：不是替换你的指令，而是让每一次 UI/排版任务开始前，Agent 都知道本地有一套可复用的真实设计系统；不够用时，它还会自己去网上找参考并沉淀下来。

### 三个工具怎么配合

```
design_discover { query: "dark developer tool landing page", limit: 3 }   # 库里没有匹配风格 → 主动找参考并收录
design_library  { action: "list" }                                       # 看看现在有什么
design_library  { action: "export", id: "cursor", format: "tokens" }     # 取出可直接粘贴的 CSS 变量
design_capture  { url: "https://example.com", notes: "喜欢它的留白与字重" }  # 收录你指定的站点
```

抓取结果只包含设计语言（token），**不会**复制 Logo、图片或正文；`design_discover` 的候选过滤遵循同一原则 —— 只挑能用 CSS 表达的设计。

## 存储位置

默认 `~/.dsh/storages/design-forge/`：

```
index.json          # 总览索引（由 entries/ 扫描重建，可随时删除）
entries/<id>.json   # 每条设计的完整分析 + tokensCss
```

`id` 由站点名/域名生成（`acme`、`acme-2` …）；`refresh: true` 可覆盖重抓。

## 示例页面

`examples/` 里有两个用捕获结果搭出来的完整页面（单文件，浏览器直接打开，无需构建）：

| 文件 | 类型 | 设计系统来源 |
|---|---|---|
| [`examples/landing-linear.html`](examples/landing-linear.html) | 营销落地页 | `linear`（`design_capture`） |
| [`examples/console-cursor.html`](examples/console-cursor.html) | 应用界面 / 控制台 | `cursor`（`design_discover` 自动发现并收录） |
| [`examples/panel-linear.html`](examples/panel-linear.html) | 小组件面板（最小示例） | `linear` |

这三页的设计语言（配色、字阶、圆角、阴影、动效、断点）都取自对应条目，文案与图形原创；
每个文件顶部的注释写明了复用了哪些 token。详见 [`examples/README.md`](examples/README.md)。

## 配置（cordis.patch.yml 的 design-forge 行）

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `storeDir` | `~/.dsh/storages/design-forge` | 设计库目录 |
| `maxStylesheets` | 24 | 每页优先抓取的样式表数（按 URL 关键词 + 同源评分排序） |
| `hardMaxSheets` | 40 | 绝对上限：若前一批仍缺核心 token（调色板/字体），继续补抓直至该上限 |
| `maxImportsPerSheet` | 4 | 每张样式表跟进的一级 `@import` 数 |
| `maxStylesheetBytes` | 600000 | 单张样式表字节上限 |
| `maxTotalCssBytes` | 2500000 | 单次抓取 CSS 总量上限 |
| `fetchConcurrency` | 4 | 样式表并发抓取数 |
| `maxTokenProps` | 80 | 每个主题保留的 CSS 自定义属性上限（核心 token 优先于组件级 token） |
| `promptSection` | true | 是否注入系统提示 guidance section |

## 安装 / 启用 / 移除

从 Git 克隆（推荐）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/nekofinley/dsh-plugin-design-forge.git
cd dsh-plugin-design-forge
pnpm install --store-dir .\.pnpm-store   # pnpm ≥9；依赖仅 schemastery/cosmokit（hoisted）
```

然后把克隆目录接入 DSH profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`），任选其一：

- 用 `plugin_manager` 工具：`install_bundle`，target 传克隆目录的绝对路径；
- 手动：profile 的 `package.json` 中 `dsh.profile.bundles` 加入 `"dsh-plugin-design-forge"`，并以 `link:<克隆目录>` 作为该包的来源，再在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 列表加入 `[{ id: design-forge, name: dsh-plugin-design-forge, config: { promptSection: true } }]`。

已装好的管理：

- 停用：`plugin_manager` `set_bundle`（禁用后 provider、工具与提示注入全部撤销）。
- 移除：`plugin_manager` `remove_bundle`。

## 已知边界

- 只能看到**静态 CSS**：hover 才出现的样式、canvas / JS 注入的样式、需要登录的页面内容不在抓取范围内。
- 单张样式表超过上限时按前缀分析并在 `stats.truncatedSheets` 标注。
- 图片、Logo、正文内容不会被复制 —— 设计库复用的是设计语言（token），不是素材。

## 测试

```bash
node test/run.mjs          # 42 项检查:解析器、两个抓取工具、发现与过滤、库操作
node test/debug-pollution.mjs   # 回归工具:在真实样式表上找被解析器污染的值
```

测试不联网：用一个假的 `ctx.web`（fixture 页面 + 一个本地 HTTP 服务器）驱动真实的 `apply()`。

---

## English summary

A DSH bundle that captures the *real* design of excellent websites into a persistent local library and makes agents apply it automatically.

- **`design_capture`** — fetches a URL through the harness `ctx.web` seam (so the configured fetch provider, including the SOCKS proxy router, applies), parses inline styles plus every reachable stylesheet (first-level `@import` included), and distills: frequency-ranked palette (with luminance classes), font families with full stacks, type scale, weights, line heights, letter spacing, spacing rhythm, radii, shadows, gradients, motion durations/easings, media breakpoints, container widths, `@font-face` declarations, and the site's own CSS custom properties (light/dark separated by `[data-theme="dark"]`-style selectors and `prefers-color-scheme`). Stores one JSON entry plus a ready-to-paste `tokens.css`.
- **`design_library`** — `list` / `search` / `get` / `delete` / `export` (`tokens` CSS variables, `spec` Markdown design document, `json` raw).
- **`design_discover`** — one call does search → filter → batch capture: runs a web search through the harness search provider, drops platforms/aggregators, docs, assets, listing pages and duplicate hosts, prefers landing pages, captures every remaining site into the library, and returns a per-site digest (palette, fonts, type scale, radii, token counts). Pass `urls` to skip search and batch-capture known sites.
- **System-prompt section** (order 2155) — instructs every agent to check the library *before* building websites, app UIs, dashboards, emails, posters, decks, or document typography, to reuse the closest captured design's tokens, to capture sites the user praises, and to run `design_discover` when the library holds nothing close to the target.
- **Examples** — `examples/` ships two complete single-file pages built from captures: a marketing landing page (Linear tokens) and an app console (Cursor tokens found by `design_discover`). Open them in a browser; no build step.

Storage: `~/.dsh/storages/design-forge/` (`index.json` + `entries/*.json`, index rebuilt from files on demand). Zero runtime dependencies beyond `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (Config schema); all analysis is a dependency-free brace/paren-aware CSS walker. Static CSS only — hover-only, canvas, and JS-injected styles are out of scope.

plugins.description: 推理等级滑条：DSH Web composer 里模型选择器旁的胶囊，点开是整宽渐变滑条（蓝→紫随档位推进、流光扫过、白钮拖动），复用官方模型目录的会话状态。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-slider-chaunye

推理等级滑条：给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web composer 的模型选择器旁加一个胶囊，点开是**整宽的渐变滑条**——拖动即改当前会话的推理等级。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/chaunye/dsh-effort-slider-chaunye)

## 特性

- **整宽渐变滑条**：20px 药丸轨道 + 蓝→紫渐变填充 + 26px 纯白圆钮 + 数值标签居中显示在条上方
- **颜色随档位整体推进**：`Off/Low` 纯蓝、`High` 蓝紫过渡、最高档显示为 **Ultra** 且**整条都是紫**，与其他档位一眼区分
- **流光动效**：一条浅色光带每 2.4s 从左扫到右（用 `transform` 走合成器，不逐帧重绘），最高档另有呼吸光晕；`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下全部关闭
- **与官方模型菜单共用同一份状态**：读取 DSH 自己的 per-session 模型目录（`ctx.modelDirectories`），改档走同一条 `session.selectModel`，所以两处显示永远不会打架
- **不做做不到的事**：当前模型没有声明推理等级时**完全不渲染**（不出现动不了的控件）；只声明 1 档时退化为只读徽标
- **拖动一次只提交一次**：松手才写档位，不会因为划过 4 个刻度就写 4 次
- **零网络请求**：不联网、不读文件、不引入任何第三方依赖，只调用 DSH 自身的接口

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add github:chaunye/dsh-effort-slider-chaunye
```

例如 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:chaunye/dsh-effort-slider-chaunye`。

安装后**重启一次 DSH**（新 bundle 需要重启加载；之后的改动走客户端热替换，不用再重启）。

- **桌面版用户**：`--profile desktop` 由 Electron 独占（CLI 会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），请在应用内的「设置 → 插件市场」安装，或用本仓库的 `tools/install-into-profile.mjs` 手动安装。
- **从这个仓库直接安装不会触发任何构建**：本插件是手写的 classic script，仓库里就是运行产物，不需要 `prepare` 脚本、也不需要 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 授权。

## 使用

1. 点 composer 中模型选择器旁的胶囊（胶囊上有一个跟随档位变色的小圆点）。
2. 拖动滑条、点刻度，或用 `←`/`→` 逐档；`Home`/`End` 到两端；`Esc` 收起。
3. 改档立即生效于**下一次请求**；正在跑的那一步不会被中断。

## 要求与权限

- **DSH 版本**：≥ `0.2.0-rc.1`（开发与实测在 `0.2.0-rc.2`）。用到的接口：`ctx.modelDirectories`（per-session 模型目录）、`session.selectModel`（改档 RPC）、`conversation.input.activity`（composer 座位）、`react` / `react-dom`（平台模块表）。
- **平台**：Web 半边，任何能跑 DSH Web GUI 的平台；已在 Windows + 桌面版实测。
- **权限声明**：不需要任何额外权限。不执行命令、不读写文件、不发起网络请求、不向模型注册任何工具。
- **外部服务**：无。

## 已知限制（实测，不是推测）

- **档位之间的实际差异未被证实**：同一道可判对错的题、temperature 0、n=10/档的对照实验里，`low/high/max` 的 reasoning tokens 均值 148/143/161（区间 97–228 大幅重叠），正确率 9/10、10/10、10/10，延迟基本相同。阴性结果不足以断定网关忽略 `reasoning_effort`（题目可能过易、样本过小），因此滑条**如实透传**网关词汇，**不代表"档位越高越强"**。唯一有确定性效果的是 `off`（发 `thinking:{type:disabled}`，`reasoning_content` 消失）。
- **最高档显示名 `Ultra` 只是展示层**：发给网关的仍是该档位自己的 id（如 `max`）；DSH 官方模型菜单里仍显示适配器给出的名字（适配器的档位名是硬编码的，配置改不了）。
- **改档会同时成为"新会话默认"**：DSH 的 `selectModel` 内部会调用 `agentDefaultModel.saveSelection()`，插件侧无法关闭这一行为。
- **与官方模型菜单的档位名可能不一致**（见上一条），这是有意为之的显示层选择。

## 演示

- [`demo/mockup.html`](./demo/mockup.html) —— 自包含的可交互原型：可拖动、切换深浅色、对比两种渐变、开关动效。直接双击用浏览器打开即可（不需要 DSH）。

## 开发与验证

```sh
node tools/validate.mjs    # 清单/产物规则校验（含一条 portal 自定义属性作用域检查）
node tools/smoke.mjs       # 36 项行为断言，无需浏览器（自带微型 hook 运行时驱动组件）
```

装进某个 profile 后，还可以用 DSH 自己的启动代码离线验证组合结果（需以 Electron 的 Node 模式运行，因为插件宿主代码在 `app.asar` 内）：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = "1"
& "<安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals `
    tools\verify-profile-composition.mjs "<安装目录>\resources\app.asar" "<home>\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
```

它打印 `COMPOSITION OK` / `COMPOSITION INCOMPLETE`，并分别报告「loader 里有没有这一行」和「设置里的插件列表会不会显示它」。注意列表页只列 `installed`（即 profile `dependencies` 里声明了该包）的 bundle，所以只往 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加名字会让插件**能加载但不出现在列表里**——这个脚本就是用来抓这种半装状态的。

想移植到其它宿主（MiMo / OpenCode 等）请读 [`PORTING.md`](./PORTING.md)：里面逐行标出了「DSH 专属层」与「可移植层」。

## 许可证

MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE)。

# dsh-plugin-dev-mpff

## 这是什么

一个给「dsh（DeepSeek Harness）第三方插件作者」用的 skill —— 覆盖从零写出一个插件、证明它真的生效、把它发出去的全过程。

## 覆盖什么（任务清单）

- **找 CLI / 安装根 / Node / profile** —— 先确认这台机器上的 dsh 环境在哪，再动手
- **写 manifest 与 patch** —— `package.json` 的 `dsh` 块、bundle patch 与层序
- **挑扩展点** —— 决定挂工具流水线、前端槽位还是事件
- **从零建包** —— 逐文件写出一个能跑的插件包
- **写前端半边** —— `dsh.client` 与 `client.js`
- **验证真的生效** —— 装上、mount、卸干净，每一步都有判据
- **发布与兼容性声明** —— 发到 npm 时要说清的兼容性面
- **排查静默失效** —— 插件装上了却什么都不做，从哪开始查
- **升级后重新核对** —— dsh 升级之后，哪些事实必须重新确认
- **把 skill 随包发出去** —— 让包里的 skill 真的被宿主发现，而不是装上了却静默不可见

## 边界在哪（不覆盖什么）

- 不覆盖「使用或配置一个已装插件」—— 那是使用者的事，不是作者的事
- 不覆盖「改 shipped preset」—— 官方发行版自带的组合不在第三方扩展点里
- 不覆盖「dsh 宿主本身开发」—— 宿主主循环与官方自带插件不在范围内
- 不覆盖「安装或放置这个 skill 本身」—— 落点与优先级由宿主自己的 skill 发现规则决定，本仓库不定义落点，只给一个照做用的示例
- 不覆盖「版本与变更历史」—— 本仓只有一处版本面：GitHub Releases 的 tag（不写当前版本号、不列变更历史，版本与变更都从那里读）
- 不覆盖「副本对齐」—— 取用者手上的目录束与仓库之间没有可比版本面（按 clone 取用的自带 `refs/tags`，是已知例外）

## 怎么被触发

本 skill 靠 frontmatter 的 `description` 被模型发现与触发：读者不必记路径，说清「我在写 / 装 / 发 / 查一个 dsh 插件」就够了。

- **触发面**（`description` 里的中文触发词）：dsh 插件开发、新建插件、插件包骨架、bundle patch、cordis.patch.yml、cordis 组合、宿主插件、client manifest、前端/UI 插件、扩展点选择、本地安装与验证、npm 发布、插件静默失效排查
- **排除面**（`description` 的 `Do not use for …` 一段）：使用或配置一个已装插件、改 shipped preset、dsh 宿主本身开发

`description` 是触发词与排除面的唯一真源，本节只是它的索引。被触发之后，`SKILL.md` 是唯一入口：路由表与 5 步流程在那里，其余内容（10 册分册、两套模板、闭环夹具、脚本）按需加载。

## 目录结构

取用 = 把 `dsh-plugin-dev-mpff/` 这一层整个拿走（连同 `references/`、`templates/`、`examples/`、`scripts/`）；落点与优先级由你的宿主的 skill 发现规则决定。

落点 = 把 `dsh-plugin-dev-mpff/` 这一层**整层**放进任一被扫描根的顶层，即 `<root>/dsh-plugin-dev-mpff/SKILL.md`。最省事的是**项目级根** `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills/`（= 你的会话工作区向上最近含 `.git` 的祖先，没有就是会话目录本身；**不是**你刚 clone 下来的这个仓），不想动任何既有 profile 就用它；跨项目常驻则用**用户级根** `<dshHome>/skills/`。根按优先级排序，同名时高优先者胜（宿主文档里叫 rank，数字随宿主版本可能变，以宿主文档为准）。

完整根表与优先级（还有平铺形态 `<name>.md`）见你宿主自带的 skill 发现文档：dsh 的 skill 提供方包（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`）的「根目录与优先级」一节。
